_comment: Machine-readable expectations for scripts/regress.py. Times in seconds; tol = +-seconds (default 1.5). 'category' is checked when given. 'forbid' ranges must not overlap any segment; must_not_skip = zero skip segments. Keep in sync with testset.md. 'start_late_ok' allows a later-than-expected start by that many seconds, 'end_early_ok' an earlier end. An entry may carry 'meta' (title, creator, channelId, kind, description, paidPromotion, duration) sent with the request, an 'id' when the same video appears twice, and 'expect_meta' (hints, brand, creator, duration, disclosure) checked against the job and the stats row. Rows are human-verified unless they say "verified": false. "source": "transcript-labeled" rows were labeled from a reading of the transcript, independent of the pipeline's output, and not checked by a human. "source": "pipeline-snapshot" rows expect what the pipeline produced when they were added (a change guard, not truth); "source": "needs-label" rows are replayed and printed but not checked until someone labels them ('question' says what to label).
